blocks.html: The provisions of Article VI, Chapter 2 (Special Regulations Applying in the Waterfront Area), shall not apply in the Special Southern Roosevelt Island District. In lieu thereof, the area between the shoreline and the western street line of the West Loop Road and the area between the shoreline and the eastern street line of the East Loop Road shall be used exclusively for open recreational uses, and shall be accessible to the public at all times.
blocks.plainText: The provisions of Article VI, Chapter 2 (Special Regulations Applying in the Waterfront Area), shall not apply in the Special Southern Roosevelt Island District. In lieu thereof, the area between the shoreline and the western street line of the West Loop Road and the area between the shoreline and the eastern street line of the East Loop Road shall be used exclusively for open recreational uses, and shall be accessible to the public at all times.
